chapters.label: Maracanã, 2014
chapters.text: Rio de Janeiro, 2014, the World Cup. Colombia play Uruguay at the Maracanã. The ball is headed to Rodríguez... chest, turn, volley! Off the crossbar and in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. His back is to the goal, but first he takes a quick look over his shoulder. Now he knows where the goal is.

chapters.label: Chest and volley
chapters.text: From behind the goal. He cushions it on his chest, spins, and volleys with his left foot. It dips over the keeper's fingertips!

chapters.label: Chest, turn, volley
chapters.text: Cushion the ball on your chest, turn, and volley it before it touches the ground!
